company.name: Paper Media
company.tagline: Where visual storytelling meets strategy, brand growth, and digital distribution.
company.description: Paper Media is a social media management and digital marketing agency co-founded by Atharv Kamble. It serves as the professional ground where cinema-grade visual storytelling converges with algorithmic strategy — turning raw visual concepts into high-engagement brand campaigns, organic distribution engines, and distinctive digital identities.

services.title: Social Media Management
services.description: End-to-end channel governance, calendar architecture, brand voice positioning, and organic audience nurturing across platforms.

services.title: Video-First Content Strategy
services.description: High-retention short-form reels, cinematic episodic drops, and narrative frameworks engineered for maximum algorithmic lift.

services.title: Creative Direction & Production
services.description: Full-stack visual production from concept, lighting, and sound design to custom typography and editorial color grading.

services.title: Brand Identity & Distribution
services.description: Translating commercial goals into measurable reach through multi-format distribution and strategic audience funnels.
